item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We must act before that clock starts.

2. We cannot protect essential services by surrendering control of them. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We demand safeguards before it is built.

3. We refuse to treat control of our power, water and communications as an experiment. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We must prevent that loss of control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We cannot accept that outcome. We depend on power grids, water systems, communications networks and transport to sustain everyday life, and we must keep those systems under human control. We demand enforceable safeguards before superintelligent AI is built, not promises to intervene after control has been lost. We reject the idea that speed of development matters more than public safety. We must organise now, insist on accountability and make protecting essential infrastructure a condition of every decision about the development of superintelligent AI.
